name: avatar
summary: Identifies a person, team, or integration with accessible initials.

agent.useWhen: A person, team, or integration needs a compact initials-based identity marker with a meaningful accessible name.
agent.avoidWhen: The image is content rather than an identity marker, or an image avatar is required; image admission is deferred from this initials-only contract.

invariants: Initials and the accessible label are required, nonblank text without control characters; initials contain at most three Unicode grapheme clusters.
The wrapper is a named role=img and visible initials are hidden from assistive technology to prevent duplicate naming.
The component is static and noninteractive and owns no commands, routes, browser lifecycle or JavaScript.
This contract is initials-only. src, image, and imageSource inputs are not admitted; image support and its safe URL policy are deferred.
The fragment has exactly one [[avatar]] slot; the renderer escapes initials and label and rejects malformed or unsupported slots.
